about: The tests allowed to skip in CI (scripts/test-skips.mjs), each for one runner (node:test, pytest, playwright) and one OS (process.platform) with why it cannot run there. Only shrinks: an entry whose test runs fails its run, and src/test/testSkipGate.test.ts holds the count to a ceiling.
